description: This file defines an abstract test runner class 'TocFaultTransactionTestRunner' for testing transaction fault scenarios in Orleans. It includes methods for executing multi-grain transactional operations with simulated commit failures and exceptions to verify transactional behavior and error handling.

classes.name: TocFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for testing transaction fault scenarios involving multiple grains, with methods to simulate commit failures and exceptions.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitFailure
methods.description: Executes a multi-grain transaction, intentionally induces a commit failure with 'FailOperation', and verifies that the transaction is aborted as expected.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransactionWithCommitException
methods.description: Executes a multi-grain transaction, intentionally induces a commit exception with 'ThrowOperation', and verifies that the exception is properly thrown and grains retain expected state.
